scripts.check:python: python -m compileall -q src tests migrations tools main.py
scripts.lint:python: PYTHONPATH= uv run --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt ruff check . && PYTHONPATH= uv run --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt ruff format --check .
scripts.type:python: PYTHONPATH= uv run --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt mypy src tests
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH= uv run --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt python -m pytest tests/test_database_url.py tests/test_control_plane_validation.py tests/test_notification_role_panel.py tests/test_resource_service.py tests/test_sqlite_postgres_cutover.py -q
scripts.build: npm run check:web && npm run test:web && npm run check:python && npm run lint:python && npm run type:python && npm run test:python && mkdir -p public && cp -R docs-site public/docs-site
